title: Durable capability versus transient capacity
summary: NodeCapabilityStatement represents comparatively durable facts such as jurisdiction, trust/access/ability/runtime/architecture and API-egress capability. NodeCapacityObservation separately represents short-lived free memory/disk/CPU, WLU rate, queue depth and active jobs, bound to a capability generation and expiry.
invariants: Capacity cannot repair a missing capability.
Capacity observations must match the advertised capability generation.
Capacity evidence has an expiry and therefore bounds lease freshness.
